results.title: FormFusion | Document Delivery and Design for Higher Education
results.content:
##### Undue Burden on Staff

Do you find your processes to be very manual and time consuming, affecting your ability to get other work done? Are you asked to include data that the pre-built forms can't accommodate? Are you hearing complaints about layout or delivery? With FormFusion, you set up both the forms and the processes to your specifications and then let them run. Then, they just work. Your end users won’t even know they’re utilizing FormFusion.

## FormFusion works for you  wherever your data resides

In the ever-changing world of higher education, data of various types – regardless of where it resides – must be included in key forms and documents. With FormFusion, you be confident in your ability to include that data, whether it sits in an on-premise system or in the cloud. [...] ## Why Would I Need FormFusion?

You may be asking yourself that very question. After all, the forms and processes you have in place may be working just fine in your eyes. But maybe it’s time to take a second look. Consider these reasons why FormFusion could be needed at your institution.

##### Excessive Costs

Are you outsourcing processes to third parties? Do you require storage of forms and paper stock? Both result in added costs for your institution. FormFusion saves you money by bringing processes in-house, eliminating paper stock, and reducing postage and document delivery costs. (FormFusion is a great tool to help your campus “go green!”)

##### Unable to Serve Clients in a Timely Manner [...] ##### Unable to Serve Clients in a Timely Manner

Do your current processes negatively impact your ability to serve your clients – whether they be students, staff, or vendors – in a timely and efficient manner? With FormFusion, you can set up those forms and documents, and automate the processes behind them, so that your clients can receive and respond in the timeframe needed.
